findings: False precision of stated price dates: the chat facts gave a month-precise stated date (Stand 09/2026) as the end of the month (2026-09-30); 9 of 68 graph-on answers repeated such a day. Fixed after the run in ChatFacts (the date as precise as the page wrote it), with a regression assertion in BusinessViewTest.

Generic services: the rule extractor adds vocabulary-level services ("Sanitär", "Sanierung", "Heizung") next to the specific ones of the page; answers list them as services. Not false, less precise; left as is for package 6.

reanswers.note: After the date fix the graph-on contexts of 8 questions changed (only the stated price dates: 2026-09-30 -> 2026-09 and alike); their 16 graph-on answers were answered again under new task ids (run label date-precision) and all 16 were read.
reanswers.verdict: 16 of 16 correct and complete; none repeats a day the page did not state (0 of 16, before: 9 of the 68 graph-on answers); stale and current prices of Sonnenhof kept apart in Q10, Q14, Q30; Q32 still a correct "weiß ich nicht".
